metaDescription: Standard delivery targeting 24 hours and DOOM EXPRESS targeting 6 hours across the Sultanate of Oman, with secure handover codes.
title: DOOM EXPRESS

hero.title: Delivered fast. Handed over securely.
hero.text: Every order is prepared, tracked step by step and handed over with a one-time code. Delivery times and fees come from the configuration of your zone — shown before you pay.
hero.target: Target {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
hero.standardText: For every configured zone, at the price set for your area.
hero.expressText: When your zone offers it and same-day capacity remains.

how.title: How the delivery fee is calculated
how.intro: The fee is computed automatically from the rates configured for your zone and displayed at checkout. Nothing is added after payment.
how.base: Base fee of the zone (governorate or wilaya).
how.weight: Per started kilogram beyond the weight included in the base fee, when a per-kg rate is configured. The chargeable weight is the greater of the actual weight and the volumetric weight (volume in cm³ ÷ 5000).
how.volume: Per started litre of volume, when a bulky-item rate is configured.
how.express: Express surcharge of the zone, added for DOOM EXPRESS.
how.free: Free standard delivery above the threshold set for the zone, if any.
how.includedWeight: Weight included in the base fee: {kg} kg.

capacity.title: Promises that match real capacity
capacity.text: DOOM EXPRESS is only offered while same-day capacity remains in your zone. A delivery type that is not configured is shown as unavailable instead of an invented promise.
capacity.cutoff: Express orders are accepted until {hour}:00, Muscat time.
capacity.noCutoff: Express availability depends on the capacity remaining today in your zone.

zones.title: Delivery zones
zones.intro: Live configuration of the 11 governorates. Fees appear as soon as they are set by our logistics team.
zones.within: Target {hours, plural, one {# h} other {# h}}
zones.configuredCount: {count, plural, =0 {No zone configured yet} one {# zone configured} other {# zones configured}}

handover.title: Secure handover
handover.otpText: When your parcel is out for delivery, a 6-digit code appears on your order page. The courier needs it to complete the delivery.
handover.proofText: The courier records the receiver's name and a photo, stored encrypted and visible on request.
handover.trackingText: Confirmed, preparing, packed, courier assigned, out for delivery, delivered — with notifications at key steps.

statusHint.CONFIRMED: Payment confirmed, your order is queued for preparation.
statusHint.PREPARING: Our team is preparing your items.
statusHint.PACKED: Your parcel is packed and ready to leave.
statusHint.COURIER_ASSIGNED: A courier has taken charge of your parcel.
statusHint.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: Your parcel is on its way to you.
statusHint.FAILED: The delivery attempt did not succeed.

reasons.invalid_input: Delivery cannot be calculated for this order.
reasons.zone_not_found: We do not deliver to this area yet.
reasons.zone_inactive: Delivery to this area is temporarily paused.
reasons.not_configured: Delivery is not yet configured for this area.
reasons.express_not_offered: Express delivery is not offered in this area.
reasons.not_express_eligible: One of the items cannot be delivered express.
reasons.parcel_unknown: The parcel weight is not known yet for this order.
reasons.capacity_full: Today's delivery capacity is full in this area.
reasons.capacity_not_configured: Express capacity is not configured for this area.
reasons.after_cutoff: Express orders for today are closed (cut-off passed).

courier.title: Courier workspace
courier.subtitle: Your deliveries for today.
courier.emptyText: New deliveries appear here as soon as they are assigned to you.
courier.emptyDoneText: Completed and failed deliveries of the last 7 days appear here.
courier.noGps: No GPS location — use the address and call the customer.
courier.pickedUpDone: Delivery started. The customer now sees the handover code.
courier.handoverText: Ask the customer for the 6-digit code shown in their order, take a photo of the handed-over parcel and enter the receiver's name.
courier.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · max 8 MB.
courier.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {Wrong code — # attempt left} other {Wrong code — # attempts left}}
courier.otpLocked: The code is locked after too many wrong attempts. Logistics has been alerted and can issue a new code.
courier.otpExpired: The code has expired. Ask logistics to issue a new one.

errors.not_found: This delivery does not exist or is not assigned to you.
errors.invalid_transition: This action is not possible at the current step.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.order_not_active: This order is no longer active.
errors.courier_required: A courier must be assigned first.
errors.use_complete_delivery: Deliveries are completed with the handover code.
errors.otp_not_issued: No handover code was issued for this delivery.
errors.photo_invalid: This photo format is not supported (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 8 MB).
errors.generic: The action failed. Please try again.
